main_sweep: 0.10..0.90 step0.0001 inclusive, identical grid for all methods
helper_grid: 0..1 step0.0001, used for matching, not new scientific result
score_comparison: float32 probability >= float32 threshold, native resolution
FOV_GT: same sealed Dev28 reference, FOV includes original U; no GT relabeling
aggregation: fixed28 per-image macro; pooled counts separately labelled
Precision_empty: NA, never discard an image to improve macro
AP: exact unique-score grouped average precision per image, macro across28; not trapezoidal PR-AUC
calibration: 20 uniform positive-probability reliability bins, Brier, clipped NLL; ECE descriptive, background dominated
matched_recall: nearest observed macro Recall at one global threshold; residual<=0.0001
matched_FP: smallest global threshold meeting macro FP/FOV<=target; residual reported
GT_distance: reuse native Euclidean <=1/>1 partition, exploratory geometric proxy not medical class
bootstrap: 1000 whole-image pairs PCG64 seed20261016; conditional on Dev selections, no independent validation
best_thresholds: optimistic same-Dev diagnostic maxima only; no threshold deployment or protocol revision
